data.title: Goalkeeper Owono handed 12-match ban after De Miguel death - Al Jazeera
data.content: *Owono and De Miguel ⁠collided during a Spanish second-tier match between FC Andorra and ​Tenerife on November 2.*. FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono was suspended for 12 matches by the Spanish football federation’s disciplinary committee on Friday after his challenge on Jesus de Miguel resulted in the death of the Tenerife forward last week. Owono was sent off in the second division clash on November 2 after racing into midfield and colliding with De Miguel while trying to clear an aerial ball. “The assessment of the conduct under consideration in these proceedings must be based on the facts expressly recorded in the referee’s report, which states that the player was sent off for ‘violently striking an opponent in the chest with his leg, using excessive force, while the ball was in play’,” said the committee in a statement. Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper ‌Owono said he was enduring the “hardest days of my life” after De Miguel’s death.
